transcript: I never go see movies, but I was supposed to see a matinee, and I arrived literally right after they cut off the no late seating policy, and so they wouldn't let me in, and I found myself with free time. So I went to go see digger because I had heard such mixed things that I was so intrigued. And no spoilers, but if you follow me for the content that I post on here, you should go see digger. And it's not even like I don't think it's a perfect film. I do think it does what it wants to do successfully. I did fall asleep multiple times in it because I thought there were scenes that just went on so long. But ultimately, it gets the message across that it's trying to send. And it's a film that I will be thinking about for a very long time. And as many times as I go see a show, and I think to myself, wow, this is really timely. This is the kind of theatre that we need right now. This is going to change the world. I think digger is the kind of movie to remind me that we also do actually need to take action in the world. Uh, that the art is good, but art without action is essentially useless. So, uh, yeah, I think. I think if you. If you like my content, you will probably at least get something out of digger.
